title: US Stamp 1948 Five Tribes Oklahoma - 3 Cent Stamp - First Day Of Issue
descriptionText: The product is a 1948 US postage stamp featuring the Five Tribes of Oklahoma, with a denomination of 3 cents. This single stamp was issued on the first day of its release and is in used condition. It is from the United States and has not been certified. This collectible stamp showcases an important aspect of American history and culture, making it a valuable addition to any stamp collection.
